relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 activity is shown to be required for corneal neurodegeneration to occur in a murine model of DED.

relationships.subject: SB-366791
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 inhibition ameliorated DED-induced nerve fiber loss in the midepithelial vertical fibers

relationships.subject: dry eye disease
relationships.evidence_quote: This finding indicates that DED brings about sensitization of TRPV1-expressing corneal fibers

key_findings: TRPV1 knockout or antagonist SB-366791 protected deeper corneal nerves from DED-induced degeneration without affecting epitheliopathy or tear production.
DED sensitized TRPV1 to capsaicin and caused TRPV1-dependent pain signs; effect not due to CD4+ T cells.
